frequency_question: What proportion of expiring bilateral water treaties are renewed rather than lapsing?
membership_rule: Includes any official, ratified treaty governing shared water resources between two adjacent sovereign states that required a formal extension, renegotiation, or successor pact by a specific deadline. Excludes multilateral agreements and non-binding memoranda of understanding.

cases.name: US-Canada Columbia River Treaty regime reviews
Namibia-South Africa Vioolsdrift Dam agreement extensions
India-Pakistan Indus Waters Treaty continuous operation despite tensions
Lesotho Highlands Water Project phase agreements
Ukraine-Moldova Dniester River Basin Treaty implementation

coverage_note: 8 prominent international water treaty renewal/continuation events identified; believed roughly 10 in total globally within major frameworks.
known_gaps: Minor bilateral arrangements between smaller developing states lacking public digital archives may be underrepresented.
validity_reason: International water law norms and the high sunk costs of abandoning cooperative basin management structures change slowly over a multi-year horizon.
